title: Review plan input
description: What the model collected and judged, written to one JSON file outside the project.

account.description: The current account's login, from the same API and in the same form as every author login; on GitHub, GraphQL viewer.login.

threads.description: Every review thread of the request, resolved ones included.

classifications.description: The model's judgment per open thread, per comment-kinds.md. A resolved thread the account never replied in stays unclassified.

decisions.description: Each choice the user stated in the conversation.

summaries.description: The request's comments, so the planner finds the summary to update.

summaryChoice.description: The comment ID the user picked among the output's candidates, or "new" when allowNew was true.

learnings.description: Feedback worth keeping, per learnings.md; for a legacy summary, its learnings worth keeping.

labels.description: The summary's visible words, in the replies' language.

userCall.description: The heading of the questions waiting for the user.

todo.description: The heading of the changes not pushed yet.

thread.description: The text of each link to a thread.

replyAuthors.description: Each reply's author login, the opening comment excluded.

lastReply.description: The last reply's full body, hidden marker included.

lastReplyId.description: The last reply's native ID, so an edited or repeated message is detected.

newCommit.description: A commit was pushed since the last reply, whether or not it fixes the request.

text.description: The reply in one or two lines, without its source.

source.description: Required for done, the pushed commit's SHA, and for answer, its evidence.

text.description: The choice acknowledged in one or two lines, with its decision label.

source.description: The user's message that states it.
